notes.title: New Updates - Patch 1.1.5
notes.content:
Hey Romans!

Pax Romana: Romulus continues to develop with each passing day. Here's is a list of what's going on:

[list]
[*]Added a new skill system, foraging, mining, fishing and hunting. You can gain experience points by collecting wood, stone, farming and fishing. As experience points increase, you'll be faster and collect new products.
[*]Added fishing system. On the banks of the river you will see fishing spots. Every fishing spot has 24 hour time for renew.
[*]Energy point increased from 100 to 120.
[*]Trees and shrubs were reduced, allowing players to move around the map more easily.
[*]Fixed missing images in craft menu.
[*]Fixed grammatical errors in the tasks menu.
[*]Removed auto save.
[*]Changed main menu skin.
[/list]

notes.title: About the Release Date & More
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We hope, you guys are still with us. We'd like to say something about our game. 

[h1]About Release Date[/h1]
We know that we promised to release our game today (27 May 2019), but we have a small issue. Don't worry it's not about the game. The game is generally fine. The problem is game analysis of Steam. 

When we tried to set the release date, we changed something by mistaken and Steam thought we've add new files. They are analyzing our game again and [u]we must wait for a few days more[/u]. 

Pax Romana: Romulus will be released as soon as possible.

[h1]Bugs and Fixes[/h1]
Thanks to your feedbacks; we have found a chance to fix some bugs. Here are some of them. Continue to send us your feedbacks and thoughts, it helps us much. We are trying to give you the best experience.
[list]
[*] Night ambiance is fixed.
[*] Speed of hunger and energy bars are edited.
[*] More random supplies are added in map.
[*] Some quest bugs are corrected.
[*] Missing dialogues are added.
[*] Non-accessible places are available now.
[*] More NPC and environmental stuff etc. are added.
[*] The pin showing the current location on the map is added.
[/list]
[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Please don't forget, Pax Romana: Romulus will be on early access. This means, we will fix every problem you see and add new quests, features... We hope, you'll like it.

Thank you for being patient all this time. See you soon.

notes.title: Pax Romana: Romulus is on Steam now!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Our first game [i]Pax Romana: Romulus[/i] has been accepted and published. There are still a lot of things to complete our game. We thought, it’ll be better to upgrade our game with your feedbacks and ideas. Therefore, early access process will begin in [u]May 2019[/u].

We are a very small game studio, called [i]Locus Ludus[/i] and working on this game since the beginning of 2018. There has been so many changes in game and in our lives till today. Well, here we are now! And we need your support. 

Your opinions and ideas are so important to us. Please let us know what you think about our game. Of course, it's hard to know before playing. We just need you to tell us, what kind of things you want to do in our game. You can learn more from store page and write to us through Steam or e-mail. 

E-Mail: [u]info@locusludus.com[/u]

One more thing! Of course, subscription is much more important in this process. 

If you liked [i]Pax Romana: Romulus[/i], don't forget to add it in your wish list and follow us for development updates.

[b]Stay tuned![/b]
